title: Robata-Style Korean Bean Dishes
description: A hearty and flavorful dish combining navy beans with the bold flavors of Korean cuisine, all wrapped up in the smokiness of robata.

ingredients.name: white beans
ingredients.amount: 1 cup dried, soaked overnight and drained

ingredients.name: navy beans
ingredients.amount: 1 cup dried, soaked overnight and drained

instructions: 1. Preheat the robata to medium-high heat.
2. In a large pot, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
3. Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Add the navy and white beans and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Add the robata sauce, soy sauce, and Korean chili paste. Stir to combine.
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
7. Stir in the green onions and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
8. Serve the bean dishes hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
